subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — live URL embed, dev-server preview, browser-backed inspection

question: What trusted preview-widget boundary should OpenClaw support for live URL embeds, agent-owned dev servers, and browser-backed inspection in the dashboard?
rationale: The request crosses browser state, process ownership, console/network data, and screenshot exposure boundaries, and the dashboard substrate is not yet on current main.

options.title: Read-Only Preview First
options.body: Approve only the URL embed, reload, and viewport chrome first, while deferring dev-server ownership and console/network inspection to separate design review.

options.title: Wait For Dashboard Substrate
options.body: Hold implementation until the Wave 1 dashboard stack lands or is replaced, then build against the final widget APIs.

options.title: Merge With Browser Panel Direction
options.body: Fold the work into the broader visible-browser-panel discussion if maintainers want one canonical browser UI surface instead of dashboard-widget-specific tracking.

recommendation.title: Read-Only Preview First
recommendation.body: Approve only the URL embed, reload, and viewport chrome first, while deferring dev-server ownership and console/network inspection to separate design review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main plugin-tab precedent and related browser-preview product/security review signal.
